title: Extra Cable
statement: A network had n computers numbered 1 to n joined by n − 1 cables into one tree. Then one extra cable was added between two computers. The cables are listed in the order they were laid. Return the last cable in the list whose removal leaves a tree again.
constraints: 1 <= a < b <= n, no repeated cable

answerKey.pattern: Union-find: add cables in order; the first cable whose ends are already connected closes the cycle
keyPoints: Start with every computer in its own group
For each cable, if both ends are in the same group it is the extra one
edgeCases: The extra cable is the last one
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Remove each cable and test connectivity: O(n²)
DFS to find the cycle, then pick its last cable: O(n), more code

hints: Which cable is the first to connect two computers that are already connected?
With only one extra cable, the cable that closes the cycle first is also the last cycle cable in the list.
Union-find with path compression; return the first cable with find(a) == find(b).
